pairs.target: jiǎnbào fā xiàlái shí , tǎ wéi xiān kàn le zuìhòu yíyè .
pairs.english: When the briefing arrived, Tavi looked at its last page first.
pairs.hanzi: 简报发下来时，塔维先看了最后一页。

pairs.target: nàlǐ yǒu běi gōng fāng de tú , qiáng , mén , páishuǐguǎn , háiyǒu tā dūn zài wéishéng wài kànguò de nà zhī tuōjià .
pairs.english: There was the north workshop: walls, doors, drainpipe, and the bracket he'd studied from beyond the rope.
pairs.hanzi: 那里有北工坊的图，墙、门、排水管，还有他蹲在围绳外看过的那只托架。

pairs.target: tú biān xiě zhe zàn bú fùkè .
pairs.english: “No classes yet” appeared beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 图边写着暂不复课。

pairs.target: tā fān huí dìyīyè , cái fāxiàn bàogào méiyǒu cóng xuégōng xiě qǐ , érshì cóng chéngxī bèngfáng xiě qǐ .
pairs.english: Turning back, he discovered the report began not at the academy but at the western pumping station.
pairs.hanzi: 他翻回第一页，才发现报告没有从学宫写起，而是从城西泵房写起。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī méiyǒu zhàozhe jiǎnbào niàn .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey didn't read the briefing aloud.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师没有照着简报念。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liǎngzhāng chāolù de jìlù bìngpái guà zài bǎn shàng , yìzhāng shì bèngfáng shì zhuǎn shí liúxià de , lìng yìzhāng láizì běi gōng fāng hòulái bùzhì de guāncè .
pairs.english: She hung two copied records side by side on the board: one from the pump trial, one from later observations in the north workshop.
pairs.hanzi: 她把两张抄录的记录并排挂在板上，一张是泵房试转时留下的，另一张来自北工坊后来布置的观测。

pairs.target: " zhè jǐchù shíjiān , yǐjīng héduì guò le . "
pairs.english: “These times have been checked against one another.”
pairs.hanzi: “这几处时间，已经核对过了。”

pairs.target: dāngchū bèngfáng qǐyòng de jiù tiáojié jià , jiēzhe yíduàn réng néng gōngzuò de jiù shèshī .
pairs.english: The old regulating frame started at the pumping station had been connected to a functioning section of old infrastructure.
pairs.hanzi: 当初泵房启用的旧调节架，接着一段仍能工作的旧设施。

pairs.target: wéixiūduì yánzhe mái zài dìxià de jiù xiàn , chá dào le běi qiáng fùjìn .
pairs.english: The repair crew followed buried old lines to the north wall.
pairs.hanzi: 维修队沿着埋在地下的旧线，查到了北墙附近。

pairs.target: xīn de shuǐguǎn tuōjià búshì lìliàng de láiyuán , què shǐ yuánběn yīnggāi gékāi de dìfāng chóngxīn jiētōng .
pairs.english: The new pipe bracket wasn't the source of the force, but reconnected areas that should have been isolated.
pairs.hanzi: 新的水管托架不是力量的来源，却使原本应该隔开的地方重新接通。

pairs.target: nàtiān zhǎnshì wèishénme huì shòu yǐngxiǎng , rújīn yǒu le néng duì dé shàng de lùjìng , búzài zhǐshì liǎnggè pèngqiǎo xiāngtóng de shíchén .
pairs.english: There was now a matching route explaining why the exhibition had been affected, rather than merely two coinciding times.
pairs.hanzi: 那天展示为什么会受影响，如今有了能对得上的路径，不再只是两个碰巧相同的时辰。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīngzhù tú shàng nàtiáo xìxiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi stared at the thin line on the drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯住图上那条细线。

pairs.target: tā ràoguò chúfáng xiàmiàn , yòu cóng yǐjīng fēngsǐ de xiǎoyuàn pángbiān zhuǎnchūqù .
pairs.english: It wound beneath the kitchen, then out beside a sealed courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 它绕过厨房下面，又从已经封死的小院旁边转出去。

pairs.target: nà zhèngshì tā píngcháng duān zhe wǎn zǒuguò de dìfāng .
pairs.english: He walked there carrying his bowl every day.
pairs.hanzi: 那正是他平常端着碗走过的地方。

pairs.target: luò héng jǔshǒu , wèn cānzhào tiě huáng míngmíng fàngzài mùjià shàng , wèishénme yě huì dòng .
pairs.english: Lohen raised his hand: why had the reference spring moved when it stood on wood?
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡举手，问参照铁簧明明放在木架上，为什么也会动。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ bǎn shàng de dìèrzhāng zhǐ táiqǐ lái , lùchū hòumiàn yìfú xiǎo tú .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey lifted the second sheet on the board to reveal a small drawing behind it.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把板上的第二张纸抬起来，露出后面一幅小图。

pairs.target: wéixiūduì yòng qìjù zài kōng wūlǐ zuò guò guāncè , yǒuxiē yàngpiàn xuán zhe , réng chūxiàn xiǎngyìng .
pairs.english: The repair crew had used instruments to observe the empty room; some suspended samples had still responded.
pairs.hanzi: 维修队用器具在空屋里做过观测，有些样片悬着，仍出现响应。

pairs.target: jiù shèshī xíngchéng de zuòyòng fànwéi , bìng bù zhī zài nàtiáo liánxiàn běnshēn .
pairs.english: The old installation's reach wasn't confined to the connecting line itself.
pairs.hanzi: 旧设施形成的作用范围，并不只在那条连线本身。

pairs.target: xiàn tōngxiàng de shì jiù zhuāngzhì , búshì shēncháng de yì shuāngshǒu .
pairs.english: The line led to an old device; it wasn't a pair of elongated hands.
pairs.hanzi: 线通向的是旧装置，不是伸长的一双手。

pairs.target: " fànwéi duō dà ? " yǒurén wèn .
pairs.english: “How wide a reach?” someone asked.
pairs.hanzi: “范围多大？”有人问。

pairs.target: " zhècì liáng chū le běi wūlǐ de yíbùfen . méiyǒu liángwán de dìfāng , wǒ bù gěi nǐmen huà jièxiàn . "
pairs.english: “We measured part of the north room this time. I won't draw boundaries where measurements are unfinished.”
pairs.hanzi: “这次量出了北屋里的一部分。没有量完的地方，我不给你们画界线。”

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhe qiēduàn liánjiē hòu de nà zǔ jìlù .
pairs.english: She pointed to the records after the connection was severed.
pairs.hanzi: 她指着切断连接后的那组记录。

pairs.target: tóngyàng de guāncè wèizhì méiyǒu zài chūxiàn xiānqián de biànhuà ,
pairs.english: The same observation points no longer showed the earlier changes,
pairs.hanzi: 同样的观测位置没有再出现先前的变化，

pairs.target: dàn zhè zhǐnéng shuōmíng bèi qièkāi de zhè yìtiáo quèshí yǒuyòng , bùnéng jùcǐ xuānbù zhěngpiàn běi qiáng dōu méiyǒu biéde jiù xiàn .
pairs.english: but this only proved that the severed line had mattered; it didn't establish that the whole north wall held no other old lines.
pairs.hanzi: 但这只能说明被切开的这一条确实有用，不能据此宣布整片北墙都没有别的旧线。

pairs.target: fùchá hái zài zuò .
pairs.english: Checks continued.
pairs.hanzi: 复查还在做。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ de liǎngpiàn tiě .
pairs.english: Tavi thought of his two irons.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起自己的两片铁。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī xiàng kànjiàn le tā de niàntou , bǔ le yíjù , kètáng shàng de jiēchù , tǐjī hé xièzài yāoqiú quán búbiàn .
pairs.english: As though seeing his thought, Instructor Vey added that classroom contact, volume, and unloading requirements remained unchanged.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师像看见了他的念头，补了一句，课堂上的接触、体积和卸载要求全不变。

pairs.target: jiù xìtǒng yǒu tā de gòujiàn hé tiáojiàn , bùnéng nálái tì zìjǐ de zuòfǎ zhǎo lìwài .
pairs.english: The old system had its own components and conditions; it couldn't excuse exceptions in their own work.
pairs.hanzi: 旧系统有它的构件和条件，不能拿来替自己的做法找例外。

pairs.target: xiàkèhòu , tǎ wéi dài zhe jiǎnbào qù ménláng .
pairs.english: After class, Tavi took the briefing to the porch.
pairs.hanzi: 下课后，塔维带着简报去门廊。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài nàlǐ děng tā , jiǎo biān fàng zhezhuāng tú de cháng tǒng , tǒng gài xīn chán le yìquān xiàn .
pairs.english: Nerai waited there, a long map tube by her feet, its lid newly wrapped with cord.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在那里等他，脚边放着装图的长筒，筒盖新缠了一圈线。

pairs.target: tā míngzǎo yào lí chéng , qù héchá ràoxíng lùduàn , yǐjīng gēn jiǎn lǎoshī shuō guò .
pairs.english: She would leave the city tomorrow morning to check the detour, and had told Instructor Jian.
pairs.hanzi: 她明早要离城，去核查绕行路段，已经跟简老师说过。

pairs.target: " zhèhuí búshì zhǎo lù , shì bǎ jǐchù méi liáng quán de bǔ shàng .
pairs.english: “We're not looking for a route this time, just completing some measurements.”
pairs.hanzi: “这回不是找路，是把几处没量全的补上。

pairs.target: huílái rìzi hái méi dìng , wǒhuì bǎ néng shōuxìn de dìfāng liúgěi ménfáng . "
pairs.english: “No return date yet. I'll leave an address for letters at the gatehouse.”
pairs.hanzi: 回来日子还没定，我会把能收信的地方留给门房。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , yòu dītóu kàn zhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, then looked down at the paper again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，又低头看纸。

pairs.target: tā wèn tā zěnme le , tā bǎ tú dìguòqù , zhǐzhe chúfáng xiàmiàn nà yíduàn .
pairs.english: She asked what was wrong; he handed her the map and pointed beneath the kitchen.
pairs.hanzi: 她问他怎么了，他把图递过去，指着厨房下面那一段。

pairs.target: " wǒ yǐqián yǐwéi , yuèguò shān cái huì pèngjiàn zhèxiē . "
pairs.english: “I used to think you'd only meet these things beyond the mountains.”
pairs.hanzi: “我以前以为，越过山才会碰见这些。”

pairs.target: " wǒ dìyīcì huílái , yě zhème xiǎng . " " nà nǐ wèishénme hái wǎng wài zǒu ? "
pairs.english: “So did I, after my first return.” “Then why do you still go out?”
pairs.hanzi:
“我第一次回来，也这么想。”
“那你为什么还往外走？”

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ cháng tǒng kào wěn , xiǎng le piànkè .
pairs.english: Nerai settled the tube securely and thought a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把长筒靠稳，想了片刻。

pairs.target: " yīnwèi yǒuxiē dìfāng wǒ xiǎng zài qù . yě yīnwèi dāying guò zài nàlǐ děng xiāoxī de rén .
pairs.english: “Some places I want to see again. And I've made promises to people waiting there for news.”
pairs.hanzi: “因为有些地方我想再去。也因为答应过在那里等消息的人。

pairs.target: búshì měicì dōu tóngyígè lǐyóu . "
pairs.english: “Not the same reason every time.”
pairs.hanzi: 不是每次都同一个理由。”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jiēzhe gàosù tā yīnggāi wǎng nǎér zǒu .
pairs.english: She didn't go on to tell him where he ought to go.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有接着告诉他应该往哪儿走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fǎndǎo gèng xiǎng wèn le : zhǐ shàng méiyǒu huà chū de nà yìtóu , shìbushì yě yǒu chúfáng ,
pairs.english: Instead, Tavi wanted to ask more: beyond the edge of the paper, were there kitchens too,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维反倒更想问了：纸上没有画出的那一头，是不是也有厨房，

pairs.target: yǒurén ná zhe wǎn , cóngbù zhīdào de dōngxī shàngmiàn zǒu guòqù ?
pairs.english: people carrying bowls above things they didn't know about?
pairs.hanzi: 有人拿着碗，从不知道的东西上面走过去？

pairs.target: " yǒuxiē yǒu . " tā shuō , " yǒuxiē zhī shèng dìjī .
pairs.english: “Some places do,” she said. “Some have only foundations left.”
pairs.hanzi: “有些有。”她说，“有些只剩地基。

pairs.target: biétì méi jiàn guò de dìfāng tiāo yígè yàngzi . "
pairs.english: “Don't choose a shape for a place you haven't seen.”
pairs.hanzi: 别替没见过的地方挑一个样子。”

pairs.target: ménláng wài , mǐlā bào zhe xīn jiè de lùjī cè jīngguò , chōng tā tái le tái xiàbā ,
pairs.english: Mira passed the porch with a newly borrowed roadbed book, lifted her chin at him,
pairs.hanzi: 门廊外，米拉抱着新借的路基册经过，冲他抬了抬下巴，

pairs.target: shuō fàntáng jīntiān yǒu zhà bǐng , ràng tā bié yòu cuòguò .
pairs.english: and said there were fried cakes today; he mustn't miss them again.
pairs.hanzi: 说饭堂今天有炸饼，让他别又错过。

pairs.target: nài lěi cuī tā qù chī , tā què wèn xiàyìjiēduàn néng bunéng xué kàn zhèzhǒng tú .
pairs.english: Nerai urged him to eat, but he asked whether he could learn to read such maps next.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾催他去吃，他却问下一阶段能不能学看这种图。

pairs.target: " qù wèn wéi lǎoshī . yě wènwèn yào bǔ nǎ bùfen suànshù . "
pairs.english: “Ask Instructor Vey. And ask which arithmetic you need to catch up on.”
pairs.hanzi: “去问维老师。也问问要补哪部分算术。”

pairs.target: tā zhòu le zhòu bízi .
pairs.english: He wrinkled his nose.
pairs.hanzi: 他皱了皱鼻子。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhōngyú xiào le , shuō kàn , tā kě méiyǒu bǎ nántīng de bànjù cáng dào zuìhòu cái shuō .
pairs.english: Nerai finally laughed: see, she hadn't hidden the unpleasant half until the end.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾终于笑了，说看，她可没有把难听的半句藏到最后才说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huí jiàoshì shí , wéi lǎoshī hái mòshōu wán zhǐ .
pairs.english: When Tavi returned to the classroom, Vey was still gathering papers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回教室时，维老师还没收完纸。

pairs.target: tā gěi tā zhǐ le xīn kè dān shàng de jiù shèshī shítú kè , zài pángbiān lièchū liǎngxiàng xiān xiū nèiróng .
pairs.english: She pointed out the old-infrastructure drawing course on the new class list, then listed two prerequisites alongside it.
pairs.hanzi: 她给他指了新课单上的旧设施识图课，在旁边列出两项先修内容。

pairs.target: búshì jīntiān qiān gè míngzì jiù néng gēn rén chūqù , dàn tā kěyǐ cóng xiàzhōu de bǔkè kāishǐ .
pairs.english: Signing today wouldn't let him join an expedition, but he could start the catch-up class next week.
pairs.hanzi: 不是今天签个名字就能跟人出去，但他可以从下周的补课开始。

pairs.target: tā bǎ kèmíng chāoxiàlái , méiyǒu huàdiào suànshù nà yìháng .
pairs.english: He copied the course name without crossing out the arithmetic line.
pairs.hanzi: 他把课名抄下来，没有划掉算术那一行。

pairs.target: fàntáng lǐ , yīwén tì tā liú zhe yìzhī bǐng , zìjǐ nà zhī yǐjīng chī wán .
pairs.english: In the dining hall, Iven had saved him a cake, having finished his own.
pairs.hanzi: 饭堂里，伊文替他留着一只饼，自己那只已经吃完。

pairs.target: mǐlā kànjiàn jiǎnbào , xiān wèn yào buyào gěi sè lā jì yífèn .
pairs.english: Seeing the briefing, Mira first asked whether he'd send Sela a copy.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看见简报，先问要不要给瑟拉寄一份。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō yào , zhècì xuéxiào gěi jiālǐ yě bèi le shuōmíng , tā bǎ zìjǐ dú guò de zhè yífèn yìqǐ dài qù ménfáng .
pairs.english: Tavi said yes; this time the school had prepared explanations for families too, and he'd take his own read copy to the gatehouse with them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说要，这次学校给家里也备了说明，他把自己读过的这一份一起带去门房。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng háiyǒu bó yà tuōrén sònglái de duǎnjiān .
pairs.english: A short note Boya had sent with someone also lay on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上还有博娅托人送来的短笺。

pairs.target: ā duō shuō dēngjià zài yuànlǐ yòng le liǎng wǎn , zhào kǒu hǎo yòng , dài kòu mó yāo , dé diàn diǎn ruǎnbù ;
pairs.english: Ado had used the holder two evenings in the yard: the hood opening worked, but the belt buckle rubbed his waist and needed soft cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多说灯架在院里用了两晚，罩口好用，带扣磨腰，得垫点软布；

pairs.target: tā zìjǐ xiān diàn le . bó yà yòu tiān le yíjù , niánfèn nà jǐháng yǐjīng jìchū .
pairs.english: He'd padded it himself. Boya added that the few lines about the year had been posted.
pairs.hanzi: 他自己先垫了。博娅又添了一句，年份那几行已经寄出。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ duǎnjiān zhé hǎo , yǎo kāi hái wēn zhe de bǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi folded the note and bit into the still-warm cake.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把短笺折好，咬开还温着的饼。

pairs.target: pánzi lǐ diào xià yìxiǎopiàn sūpí , tā yòng zhǐtou shíqǐlái , tīng yīwén jiǎng héchàng shí yǒurén bǎ děng chuán chàng chéng le děng fàn .
pairs.english: A little flake fell onto his plate; he picked it up, listening as Iven told how someone had sung “waiting for food” instead of “waiting for the boat.”
pairs.hanzi: 盘子里掉下一小片酥皮，他用指头拾起来，听伊文讲合唱时有人把等船唱成了等饭。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō nà rén chàng dé méicuò .
pairs.english: Mira said the singer wasn't wrong.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说那人唱得没错。
